name: tend-yc-demo
description: TEND YC demo video (Remotion). Not part of the app build.

scripts.final: remotion render TendDemo out/render_v4.mp4 --crf=16 --x264-preset=slow --audio-bitrate=256k && ffmpeg -y -i out/render_v4.mp4 -c copy -movflags +faststart out/TEND_YC_DEMO_FINAL_V4.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -i out/render_v4.mp4 -i public/audio/score_novo.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 256k -shortest -movflags +faststart out/TEND_YC_DEMO_FINAL_V4_NO_VOICEOVER.mp4 && rm out/render_v4.mp4
scripts.voiceover: echo 'run: <python with kokoro-onnx> scripts/make-voiceover.py <kokoro model dir>'
